module.title: AlertDialog
module.description: The AlertDialog renderer and its options.

ui.name: alert-dialog
ui.summary: Renders a modal requiring an explicit confirm or cancel.
ui.guidance: Both buttons submit the enclosing `form method="dialog"` with a value, so the platform closes the dialog and records the choice in `returnValue`. They were once type="button" with no handler, which left a keyboard or pointer user inside a modal with no way out; a destructive confirmation is the last place to depend on JavaScript having loaded. role="alertdialog" with a described message is what makes a screen reader announce the consequence rather than just the title. Cancel is first in the DOM, so the platform's own initial focus lands on the safe choice. A destructive dialog that opens with Delete focused turns a stray Enter - the key the user just pressed to open it - into the deletion.
ui.keyboard: Escape closes the native dialog, and Cancel is first in the DOM so the platform's initial focus - and a stray Enter - lands on the safe choice.
